description: Matched-case selection for mechanistic instrumentation pilots. Selected from frozen Phase 0D.2 results; not a representative sample of real-world VLM failures.
selection_principles: Prefer true matched counterfactual pairs that share image_sha256.
Include correct and incorrect examples; do not only cherry-pick failures.
Distinguish composition failures from single-premise competence.
Treat probe evaluation on these cases as insufficient for independent accuracy claims.

true_matched_pairs.relationship: same_image_sha256; inverted query entities; true counterfactual pair
same_image_sha256; inverted query entities; true counterfactual pair
same_image_sha256; both incorrect in complementary definite answers

not_matched_merely_similar: Any two fork cases with different entities/images are similar failures, not counterfactual pairs.
Visual-premise controls are single-premise competence checks, not matched to chain composition cases.

notes: Selection is for instrumentation pilots only.
Probe train/test splits must expand beyond these IDs (see mechanistic design doc).
No causal patching authorized in Phase 0E.
